description.narrative:
JOINA is designed to transform youth entrepreneurship by breaking barriers to sustainable market access. While many young people have the skills and passion to build businesses, they face critical challenges—limited visibility, lack of market connections, and systemic exclusion, particularly for those with disabilities.
Through a three-pronged approach—skills development, market access, and digital innovation, it will equip young entrepreneurs with the necessary tools to thrive. First, it will providetargeted vocational and business training, ensuring that youth from all provinces, including rural and marginalized communities, gain the knowledge and skills needed to operate successful enterprises.
Second, JOINA will establish market linkages by facilitating direct connections between youth entrepreneurs and potential buyers through physical distribution points and digital integration. A key component of thiswill be the promotion of the #BuyEkhaya movement, which encourages both local communities and the diaspora to support Zimbabwean youth businesses.
To ensure that the voices of young entrepreneurs across all provinces are continuously heard and represented, JOINAwill establish a Youth Entrepreneurship <(>&<)> Employability Envoy, consisting of onerepresentative from each of Zimbabwe’s 10 provinces visited. These envoys will engage with local entrepreneurs, document challenges, and advocate for policies that foster a moreinclusive and supportive entrepreneurial ecosystem. By amplifying the needsof youth from often overshadowed regions, the envoy willplay a crucial role in bridging regional disparities and ensuring equitable opportunities for all.
Finally, JOINA will introduce areal-time digital marketplace, an innovative app designed to centralize entrepreneurship support services. This platform will showcase youth-led businesses, offer mentorship, training resources, financial literacy tools, and direct connections to buyers and investors. Additionally, the project will prioritize inclusivity by ensuring accessibility for differently-abled entrepreneurs through partnerships organizations that support people with hearing and speaking impairments. JOINA aims to train over 300 youth entrepreneurs, incubate at least 30 and build a thriving digital platform connecting youth businesses with sustainable markets.

participating-org.narrative:
Elevate Trust is a youth-led Organisation that is passionate about youth leadership and capacity building for youth development in innovation, entrepreneurship and career development. Our Three pillars; Inspire, Innovate and Enterprise, guide our activities and our initiatives focus on STEM education and careers, research, innovation and entrepreneurship, with an overarching goal of enterprising.
Elevate Trust is strategically placed to provide opportunities and initiatives to empower and encourage youth to pursue study and careers in STEM. We believe that “STEM Pays” and financial and economic outcomes improve with access to education, particularly STEM education.
Our Vision - To catalyze the development of STEAM-enabled solutions and start-up ecosystem in Zimbabwe.
Our Mission - Promoting youth leadership, entrepreneurial development and capacity building through advancing the application of Science and Technology into education and innovations which solve community problems, creating employment for the youth anchored on Innovation and Entrepreneurship for impartial contribution to economic development and improvement of livelihoods in Zimbabwe.
